sections.content: The repository defines protected paths, evidence requirements, compatibility expectations, and Windows-oriented execution rules. Changes require approved architecture support, validation, and recorded evidence.
sections.title: Repository rules

sections.content: The specification defines exact-cover validation for a canonical package, deterministic checks before semantic handling, bounded recovery, ambiguity handoff, and hash-bound lifecycle artifacts. The requested work excludes runtime and release implementation.
sections.title: Conformance scope

sections.content: The implementation contract defines staged slices from source freeze through validation, repair, recovery, and terminal dogfood. Registered Python commands and adapters execute red, green, refactor, and terminal checks with hash-bound receipts.
